# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- Make only HTML, CSS, and JavaScript changes; do not include C language code.
- Keep the cookie consent bar in normal document flow at the bottom of the page on mobile unless explicitly requested otherwise.
- Keep the three index.html hero metric cards in their original white/light styling rather than filling them with the theme green.
- Every HTML page must include `<link rel="icon" href="/assets/images/favicon.ico" type="image/x-icon">` inside its `<head>`. Use this same root-relative favicon path for all existing and newly created HTML files.
